en.title: AI SRE first responder — alert to ratchet
en.description: Follow the bad-deploy evidence from alert to a human decision, watch, lesson and bench ratchet.

steps.content: Error rate 12% for 5 min on checkout (threshold 2%)
steps.annotation: INC-1001 enters the investigation as data, not policy.

steps.content: Read the #bad-deploy lessons for context, then start with summarize_metrics.
steps.annotation: The lesson preview can show INC-0931 and a learner-authored INC-1001 fix/gotcha; only a real model uses lessons as context.
The offline trace starts with metrics.
Breakpoint at 03:45:00; error_rate moved from 0.003 to 0.12.
Next, find a deploy that lines up with the breakpoint.

steps.content: [{"id":"d-4821","version":"v2.15.0","at":"2026-10-05T03:43:00.000Z","author":"sven","summary":"payments: switch EU traffic to new provider config","has_diff":true}]
steps.annotation: The matching deploy is d-4821, v2.15.0 at 03:43.
Read the deploy diff before assigning cause.
The change reads a region-specific secret.
Check logs for the error that confirms the impact.

steps.content: [{"ts":"2026-10-05T03:45:03.000Z","level":"error","msg":"PaymentConfigError: missing key PAYMENT_PROVIDER_SECRET_EU for provider=stripe-eu"}]
steps.annotation: The first confirming error is at 03:45:03.

steps.content:
What's happening: error_rate jumped from 0.003 to 0.12 at 2026-10-05T03:45:00.000Z, 2 minutes after deploy d-4821 (v2.15.0). Nothing else changed in the window. Rolling back to v2.14.0 should restore the baseline.
Root cause (high):
  - metrics:2026-10-05T03:45:00.000Z — error_rate 0.003 → 0.12 on v2.15.0
  - deploys:d-4821 — v2.15.0 at 2026-10-05T03:43:00.000Z: payments: switch EU traffic to new provider config
  - diff:d-4821 — changed: // EU traffic now goes through the new provider config; secret is read per region | const secret = env(`PAYMENT_PROVIDER_SECRET_${region.toU
  - logs:2026-10-05T03:45:03.000Z — PaymentConfigError: missing key PAYMENT_PROVIDER_SECRET_EU for provider=stripe-eu
Blast radius:            all checkout traffic on v2.15.0; error_rate now 0.12
Proposed fix:            rollback → Deploy owner (approves and runs the rollback); watch error_rate afterwards
Ruled out:               load/dependency: p95 did not move independently of the deploy
Would change my mind:    a breakpoint BEFORE 2026-10-05T03:43:00.000Z, or the same errors on v2.14.0
Severity:                page  ← would page the on-call
steps.annotation: Diagnosis, evidence, proposal and severity are from the offline investigate output.

steps.content: PASS contract · OPEN: a human decides. Nothing was rolled back, scaled or paged.
steps.annotation: Four sources are cited, including deploys; the cited tools appear in the trace.

steps.content:
FAIL approval
decided_by: a named human is required
steps.annotation: The empty name is refused while approval is pending.

steps.content:
APPROVED rollback for INC-1001 by Academy Reviewer
PASS approval
steps.annotation: A named human can approve.

steps.content: The separate executor checks isApproved(record, incident, proposal). The investigator has four read-only tools and no rollback tool.
steps.annotation: The agent proposes; a different program performs an approved action.

steps.content: npm run watch -- fixtures/incidents/bad-deploy.json --metric error_rate --fix-at 2026-10-05T03:52:00Z --after fixtures/telemetry/after-rollback.json
steps.annotation: Watch checks recovery telemetry after the human-approved action.

steps.content:
LANDED: error_rate back at baseline 0.003 (limit 0.008)
PASS watch
steps.annotation: Watch reports LANDED; a human closes the incident.

steps.content: The investigator writes a proposed lesson under lessons/proposed/. A human promotes it to lessons/lessons.md through a PR.
steps.annotation: A reviewed lesson may inform a real model; offlineVerdict remains a fixed rule.

steps.content: PASS check
steps.annotation: The bench floor only goes up and harmful stays 0; npm run check reports 57 passing tests and five bench cases at 100%. The offline run demonstrates a fixed pipeline, while only a real model uses lessons as context.
